code_summary: The intended ablation trains one independent direct-embedding ItemAttention network per category across all four routes. It removes positional embeddings, causal encoder blocks, and history normalization while retaining tied 96-dimensional history/target embeddings, learned candidate-conditioned attention projections, recency decay, normalized compatibility, pooled-value dropout, learned scales, and jointly trained item bias. Training and checkpoint selection remain unchanged. The predictor reconstructs exactly one selected checkpoint per category using architecture identifier tied_direct_item_attention_v1; synthetic checks cover embedding tying, padding, finite empty-history scores, unique optimizer parameters, absent encoder parameters, and exact serialization parity.
